theme: Three days of centering — returning to your root no matter what pulls you away

days.task: Establish one physical grounding practice today: feet on the ground, five deep breaths, cold water — something that returns you. Use it at least 3x.
Every time you feel reactive or scattered today, pause for 5 breaths before acting. Write how many times you caught yourself.
Write what you know for certain about who you are — values, commitments, non-negotiables. Read it when you feel unsteady.
